name: Check Unexpected Changes
on: [pull_request]

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  check:
    if: github.actor != 'copybara-service[bot]'
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
    - name: Check out repo
      uses: actions/checkout@v4

    - name: Generate the JSON Schema
      uses: ./.github/workflows/generate_jsonschema

    - name: Check for schema changes
      run: git diff --exit-code .

    - if: ${{ failure() }}
      run: |-
        echo "::error title=The JSON Schema changed!::If this is unexpected, update your branch or check for an open PR with schema changes"
        exit 1",
  "rationale": "The workflow is a pull_request check where each new commit to a PR supersedes the previous run. Pattern P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE (cancel superseded runs) applies: runs represent the same workflow and branch/PR, and a newer revision supersedes older checks. Adding a workflow-level concurrency group scoped to github.ref with cancel-in-progress cancels stale in-progress runs when a new commit lands, while the latest run still completes and satisfies the required check. This preserves all build/test coverage, adds no privileges, secrets, publishing, deployment, or new network access, and is a minimal workflow_yaml change. Evidence: P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE reported result that superseding runs reduce duplicate work; preconditions met and contraindications (release/deployment work, shared cancellation group across distinct branches) not triggered because the group is scoped to the PR ref.",
  "evidence_ids": ["P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE"]
}
